text_block_list.text:
One day, upon learning that Victoire Pisa was
joining a volunteer cleanup, I went along with her.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That trash bag is completely full, isn't it?
Thank you so much for your hard work, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Something like this is an easy fix.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's very reassuring.
...And Tran-san too.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
To accompany me practically every time...
Truly, thank you as always.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
No, no, you see, you sometimes find real treasures in places like this.
To be honest, that's what I'm actually aiming for~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So let's keep diggin' deep♪
Let's do this, Pisa-chan.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, with pleasure. However...
Please don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
There's still this much trash left.
With this amount, there's no way we can finish in one day...
choice_data_list: If only we had more hands on deck...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: You're right... If we could get more people interested in picking up trash, then perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's step by step, if everyone joins forces...
I truly believe things will change.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That's Pisa-chan for ya.
So, like, how about starting with some self-promotion or something?
choice_data_list: You really do want to catch everyone's eye, don't you?
You really do want to catch everyone's eye, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I see... Catching the eye...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what pretty accessories!
Look at this necklace, it's so sparkly!
choice_data_list: It looks like it was made from natural stone, but—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes. Actually, all of these were made from the trash we picked up the other day.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Cut up the ocean plastic,
and set it with resin to shape it—"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: With just that, you can make such beautiful accessories.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
How about this?
Wouldn't this serve as an "eye-catching appeal"...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I gotcha, I gotcha!!
Nice, nice! That's a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Digging through trash for the ultimate materials
is totally thrilling, just like a treasure hunt, right?!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really!? In that case,
I should make lots of these accessories and—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Before that~... No fair, Pisa-chan.
Keeping something this fun
a secret from me."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Let Tran-chan in on the action from here on out.
Handling info is totally my specialty, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, isn't there any fun video to watch~?
...Wait, this thumbnail is—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it's Pisa-san and Tran-san.
Uhh... "Accessories For All! The Ultimate Bang for Your Buck"...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what a gorgeous pendant!
This sparkle makes it look just like a gemstone~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still, if it's this grand...
It's gotta be super expensive, right~?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're curious, aren't you?
Actually, this pendant...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: It's practically free, you know! ♪

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "Because this pendant was handmade from garbage, after all."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: The recipe is simple, too. As long as you have the tools and genuine care, anyone can make it.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa~. Making such pretty accessories for free...
I gotta get in on this, right~?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, by all means.
...And that goes for you watching this video, too.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Would you like to make a one-of-a-kind accessory together with us?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
The only one in the entire world, huh...
That actually sounds... super awesome...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, look! Isn't this color super cute?!
I can't wait to make accessories out of it later~!
"Heheh. I've already collected this many♪"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Incredible...! There are so many people...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh~. Right according to Tran-chan's plan, I'd say.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
This'll clean up the beach too, right?
Good for you, Pisa-chan.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you so very much,
Tran-san."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
By myself, it would have been difficult
to expand our circle this much.
...Thank you for your kindness.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
No, no, thank you.
You put on quite a show for me~
choice_data_list: With the two of them, their circle might even spread around the world.
I'll try making some accessories, too!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
No, no, thank you.
You put on quite a show for me~
choice_data_list: With the two of them, their circle might even spread around the world.
I'll try making some accessories, too!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, perhaps so.
...Strangely enough, confidence is welling up inside me.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
That if we join forces with Tran-san,
we can bring hope even to people around the world.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...Pisa-chan, you really are such a good girl.
Looking at me with such honest eyes and saying that."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...! Yes, by all means.
I'm looking forward to seeing what kind of accessory it becomes♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well then, why don't the three of us make some next time?
We even have Pisa-chan here to teach us~.
Hehe♪
